title: The Tortoise, the Hare and the Harvest Race
summary: A speedy hare and a steady little tortoise race to the biggest pumpkin on the hill one autumn evening, and everyone learns that slow and steady wins the race.

title: Rumble and the Brand-New Baby
summary: A little blue dragon can't wait to show his brand-new baby sister his biggest flying tricks, and learns that being gentle, patient and helpful is the best big-brother trick of all.

title: Damian and the Great Crab Haul
summary: Damian, the youngest deckhand on a sturdy crab boat far up north, helps haul the big crab pots, figures out why the winch got stuck, sets the little crabs free, and is rocked to sleep under the northern lights.

title: From Tiny Seed to Jack-o'-Lantern
summary: A true story of how a pumpkin grows, from one tiny seed in spring to a long curly vine, yellow flowers, busy bees, a green pumpkin turning orange, and a cozy glowing jack-o'-lantern on the porch.

title: Pip the Little Glow Ghost
summary: A friendly little ghost who glows like a pumpkin lantern wants to join the Harvest Moon Party, and when the lanterns blow out, his kind glow shows everyone that looking different is a wonderful thing.

title: Ollie Otter and the Moon's Hiccups
summary: When the moon gets the hiccups and can't fall asleep, a little otter and his friends try every silly trick until a gentle lullaby and a hug do the job.
